checklist.item: Roles: provider, client(user), support, payments exist
Account owner can create subroles: installator, publicist(publisher), manager
Multi-search select: search a space, select an item, search again, select another, accumulate
Every item has a Support button; the item is attached to the support ticket as context
Provider sets up each space + Google Calendar availability or a date range
Provider and user can chat with contact info masked
Provider uploads proof of the installed ad (video for radio, photo/video per media type)
Support sees new requests with items attached (or not)
Automatic requests to support, e.g. when a proof is rejected by client (mismatch flag)
Payments role makes deposits (payouts) and refunds
Admin eagle-eye: sees all, including support and payments chats
Admin configurations; some apply to new objects only or to all objects (apply-scope checkbox)
End-to-end: map-select -> campaign -> adset -> availability/book-later -> provider accept/chat/reject -> auto-reject on file specs -> provider reject -> user refund -> support chat from any object
